Command.Name: StoreEJByTraderSystemInvNum
Command.FPOperation: Store Electronic Journal Report by Trader System Invoice Number (Single Invoice) to External SD card.

Arg.Name: OptionReportStorage

Option.Name: Storage in External SD card memory
Storage in External SD card memory for JSON

Arg.Desc: 2 symbols for destination: - 'J4' - Storage in External SD card memory - 'JX' - Storage in External SD card memory for JSON

Arg.Name: OptionTraderSystemReportFormat
Arg.Desc: 1 character with value - 'S' - Detailed EJ - 's' - Brief EJ

Arg.Name: TraderSystemInvNum
Arg.Desc: 15 symbols for trader system invoice number
